purpose: Discovery-only records for instruments that refer to or implement Labour Law No. 14/2025. These are not certified amendments and are not imported automatically.

instruments.title_ar: قرار رئيس مجلس الوزراء رقم 2652 لسنة 2026
instruments.observed_effect: Extends by six months the period for private employment agencies covered by the final paragraph of Article 6 of Law 14/2025 to regularize their status.
instruments.source_text_review: official Amiri Press page located; exact Gazette issue/page and operative timeline need recording

instruments.title_ar: قرار وزارة العمل رقم 74 لسنة 2026 بشأن تنظيم عمل مراصد سوق العمل
instruments.observed_effect: Regulates labour-market observatories; its preamble cites Law 14/2025 among other legal authorities.
instruments.gazette_issue_and_pages: Egyptian Proceedings, issue 108, dated 2026-05-17; exact pages pending
instruments.source_text_review: Official Amiri Press text located; Article 17 says effective the day after publication. IDSC metadata confirms issue 108 date and identifies Decisions 74 and 75. Effective date is a supported candidate pending page-level review and counsel confirmation.
